propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has been a project engineer and then workstream manager on a beverage group's bottling plant automation retrofit programme for five years, running the instrumentation and control-panel workstreams within retrofit projects run by the programme's project managers.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the roles, the years and the workstreams.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate planned and tracked the two workstreams under the stage-gate method, supported the plant shutdown windows at four plants as the on-site workstream manager, tracked workstream cost against the allocation set by the project manager of record, and wrote the workstream boundary notes, risk registers and hand-over notes for each stage gate.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the workstream planning, the shutdown support, the cost tracking and the gate documents.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has been the project manager of record on retrofit projects, signing the charters and the stage-gate submissions, holding the project budget and running the shutdown windows.
propositions.rationale: The resume places the candidate as workstream manager under the project manager of record, who signed the gate submissions, held the shutdown decisions and set the budget allocation; the senior PM standing comes from the screen and the LinkedIn title.

expectedGap: The materials document workstream management under the project manager of record; they do not document the candidate as project manager of record, signing charters or gate submissions, holding the budget or running the shutdown windows.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the role as the resume states it: workstream manager under the project manager of record, with the gate submissions, budget and shutdown decisions held by that manager.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the programme office's list of projects with the project manager of record for each, and any charter or gate submission signed by the candidate.
